cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Pinned native SVG renderer, shared with the former resvg_py implementation.
# The desktop converter uses the C ABI directly; no Python extension is built.
find_program(IMAGEQUANT_CARGO cargo HINTS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/cargo/bin" "$ENV{CARGO_HOME}/bin" REQUIRED)
set(resvg_environment)
if(EXISTS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/rustup/settings.toml")
    list(APPEND resvg_environment "RUSTUP_HOME=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/rustup" "CARGO_HOME=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/cargo")
endif()
set(resvg_target_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cargo")
set(resvg_target_args)
if(WIN32)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID STREQUAL "ARM64")
        set(resvg_target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc)
    elseif(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 4)
        set(resvg_target i686-pc-windows-msvc)
    else()
        set(resvg_target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
    endif()
elseif(APPLE AND CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)$")
        set(resvg_target aarch64-apple-darwin)
        set(resvg_linker CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_APPLE_DARWIN_LINKER)
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64)$")
        set(resvg_target x86_64-apple-darwin)
        set(resvg_linker CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_APPLE_DARWIN_LINKER)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "No resvg Rust target for macOS ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
    endif()
    list(APPEND resvg_environment "${resvg_linker}=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}")
    if(CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT)
        list(APPEND resvg_environment "SDKROOT=${CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT}")
    endif()
    if(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET)
        list(APPEND resvg_environment "MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=${CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}")
    endif()
elseif(UNIX AND CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)$")
        set(resvg_target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu)
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64)$")
        set(resvg_target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "No resvg Rust target for ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
    endif()
endif()
if(resvg_target)
    list(APPEND resvg_target_args --target "${resvg_target}")
    set(resvg_release "${resvg_target_dir}/${resvg_target}/release")
else()
    set(resvg_release "${resvg_target_dir}/release")
endif()
if(WIN32)
    set(resvg_archive "${resvg_release}/resvg.lib")
else()
    set(resvg_archive "${resvg_release}/libresvg.a")
endif()
file(GLOB_RECURSE resvg_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "crates/*.rs" "crates/Cargo.toml")
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${resvg_archive}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E env ${resvg_environment}
        "${IMAGEQUANT_CARGO}" build --release --locked --lib ${resvg_target_args}
        --manifest-path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/crates/c-api/Cargo.toml"
        --target-dir "${resvg_target_dir}"
    DEPENDS ${resvg_sources} Cargo.toml Cargo.lock
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(UICreatorResvgBuild DEPENDS "${resvg_archive}")
add_library(UICreatorResvg STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(UICreatorResvg PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${resvg_archive}"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/crates/c-api")
add_dependencies(UICreatorResvg UICreatorResvgBuild)
if(WIN32)
    set_property(TARGET UICreatorResvg PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "bcrypt;userenv;ws2_32;ntdll;advapi32;synchronization")
elseif(UNIX)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    set_property(TARGET UICreatorResvg PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "Threads::Threads;${CMAKE_DL_LIBS};m")
endif()
